Pax appears inside the glass of the vanity's arched mirror from f6 (pops up, watches Polly brush her hair, blushes with hearts) and no physical Pax is anywhere else in the picture: read as a mirror reflection of a lead (curator ruling: lead_copy). He does have a small shadow on the vanity top, so he might instead be standing behind an empty frame; if a verifier reads it that way the span is keepable (camera locked, compare 0/57; no overlay) | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v22): flipped to kept: not a mirror reflection: the arch has no glass tint or sheen (its inside is exactly the background colour, 211,230,237), it shows no reflection of Polly sitting beside it, and it is the same arched opening with a shaded jamb reveal that stands behind this vanity set in Traffic [83,119); Pax slides in from behind the arch's left jamb at f6-8 and stands in the opening, smaller and further back, with
